name: off_gradient_persistence
description: A reusable off-gradient-persistence module (Module M). A lineage's co-limited (Liebig-minimum) free-energy + resource budget under relaxing geological support (external gradient, mineral access, feed all declining over the run), with three toggleable innovations: internal energy conversion (has_pump), active resource import (has_importer) and information maintenance (has_heredity). Because the budget is co-limited the innovation set is irreducible — as support -> 0 only the full set keeps net budget above the survival floor, so a knockout sweep identifies {pump, importer, heredity} as the minimum robust set for autonomy. Coarse-grained, deterministic reproduction (not a wrapped ALife engine).

gradient_support.description: Starting external-gradient support, relaxed to 0 over the run (dimensionless, 0-1)

mineral_access.description: Starting mineral / FeS-catalyst access, relaxed to 0 (dimensionless, 0-1)

has_pump.description: Internal energy conversion innovation (1 present; 0 knockout)

has_heredity.description: Information-maintenance innovation; without it the machinery degrades (1 present; 0 knockout)

decline_rate.description: Support relaxation per step (1/s); support reaches 0 partway through the run

relax.doc:
Relaxes the geological support the lineage lives on — the external gradient,
the mineral (FeS) catalyst access, and the geochemical feed — each declining
linearly from its start toward a floor over the run. The off-gradient lineage
reads these and must survive their withdrawal (or not).

_contract.summary: Linearly relaxing environmental support (external gradient, mineral access, feed) — the withdrawal of geological support the lineage must survive to become autonomous.
_contract.description: Writes gradient_support / mineral_access / feed, each = max(floor, start - decline_rate * t), the relaxation of the vent's support toward zero. A controlled environmental sweep (not a scripted upgrade of the cells): whether a lineage persists as support is withdrawn is an emergent property of its innovation set.
assumptions: Monotone linear relaxation of each support channel (a controlled withdrawal, not a cell upgrade).

lineage.doc:
A lineage's co-limited free-energy + resource budget under relaxing geological
support, with three toggleable innovations (internal pump, resource importer,
information maintenance/heredity). Reads the environmental support channels and
emits survivors, net budget (fitness / free-energy flux), machinery integrity and
the energy/resource provenance — all overwrite sensors (the lineage state is
integrated internally). Deterministic and reproducible (no RNG).

_contract.summary: Co-limited (Liebig-minimum) free-energy + resource budget for a lineage under relaxing geological support, with pump / importer / heredity as toggleable innovations: which minimum set persists off-gradient?
_contract.description: Coarse-grained deterministic budget model (reproducible; not a wrapped ALife/MD engine). energy = k_ext*gradient_support + has_pump*machinery*k_pump*efficiency; resource = k_res*feed*mineral_access + has_importer*machinery*k_imp; gross = min(energy, resource) (co-limitation — neither substitutes the other); net = gross - (c_base + machinery*(has_pump*c_pump + has_importer*c_imp)). Heredity gates the machinery decay: without it machinery -> 0 over the run and the pump/importer vanish (error catastrophe). Survivors grow when net >= survival_floor and decay otherwise. Because the budget is co-limited, the innovation set is irreducible — as support -> 0 only {pump, importer, heredity} keeps net above the floor.

outputs.machinery_integrity: integrity of the adaptive machinery, gated by heredity (dimensionless, 0-1)
outputs.external_power: power tapped from the external geochemical gradient (watt)

math: m(t+1) = m(t)*(1 - decay),  decay = 0 if heredity else decay_no_heredity
assumptions: Coarse-grained deterministic budget (reproducible); the proposed integrated-modules method.
Co-limitation (Liebig minimum): growth needs BOTH usable energy AND usable resources, so a lone innovation is a cost without a co-benefit.
Heredity maintains the adaptive machinery; without it the innovations degrade (error catastrophe) and cannot be held.
Autonomy is emergent (persistence as support is withdrawn), not a scripted upgrade.

emitter.doc:
Store historical states in memory.

``subsample`` records only every Nth composite tick (default 1 =
every tick). Use this for long runs or composites with heavy
state (large fields, many agents) to keep RAM bounded — the
saved time-series still reflects the simulation's true cadence
via each row's ``global_time`` field.

``max_len`` optionally bounds ``history`` to the most recent N
recorded rows (a ring buffer): once the cap is reached each new
record drops the oldest. Default ``None`` = unbounded (the
historical behaviour — consumers such as v2ecoli that read the
full ``history`` are unaffected unless they opt in). ``max_len``
counts *recorded* rows (i.e. post-``subsample``).

_contract.description: type(name, bases, dict, **kwds) -> a new type
